title: Compliance Reports & Data Exports
subtitle: Generate on-demand audit logs, hardware inventories, patch compliance manifests, and deployment statistics
streaming_desc: Report endpoints read straight from the database and stream rows as they are produced, so a large fleet export does not have to be buffered in memory first.
inventory_desc: Complete inventory of all enrolled branch endpoints, including CPU, RAM, disk partitions, network interfaces, serial numbers, and OS versions.
patches_desc: Detailed manifest of installed and missing security updates, pending CVE hotfixes, reboot requirements, and overall fleet patch compliance rates.
deployments_desc: Full deployment lifecycle records, silent installer rollouts, target branch groups, return exit codes, and package distribution success rates.
audit_desc: Append-only security audit trail recording administrator actions, remote command dispatches, credential changes, and system modifications.
audit_restricted: The forensic audit export is restricted to administrators. The Audit tab still shows you the live trail at technician level and above.
provenance_desc: Every export is generated from the live database at the moment you request it, and each row carries its own record identifiers and RFC 3339 timestamps. Whether a given export satisfies your organisation’s audit standard — ISO 27001, SOC 2 or an internal policy — is a judgement for whoever owns that standard; this console does not certify against any of them.
